_comment: Balance as data. waves: line-up table (mix = [level key, enemy, every Nth slot, offset]); reward_taper: kill gold of an enemy of wave w is multiplied by max(floor, 1 - per_wave * (w - from)) after wave `from` (every mode), so the gold of long battles grows slower than the crowd. difficulty: campaign multipliers of health, enemy count, kill gold and castle lives (index 0 = Normal, the base the levels are tuned for). record: the Record Run (free mode, every wave harder): health grows by hp_growth per wave (capped at hp_cap), the enemy count by count_growth (capped at count_cap); the spawn window stretches to the whole wave_duration between waves window_ramp.from and .to; mix rows = [first wave, enemy, every Nth slot, offset, every Nth slot from late_from on]; boss schedule = [[first wave, every Nth wave], ...] (the latest row that has started is in force); surprise waves (first at `from`, then every `every` waves) are one enemy kind from every side, count and hp are multipliers of the ordinary wave.
